source.title: Thermal performance and flammability of poly(ethylene terephthalate) fabrics grafted with different monomers followed by electron beam irradiation

verification_limit: Four new initial plain-knitted PET textile states (100 g/m2) from DOI10.1007/s12221-014-1895-z match Table2 DTG maxima and Table3 LOI, with Table1 grafting degrees identifying PET/AAc55.4/AAm25.98/DMVP10.9. Ordinary TG uses air (Table1),10 C/min and room-temperature to600 C (Methods); numeric starting temperature, mass, pan, flow and replication are unreported. Preserve every Table2 Ti/Tm/Tf triplet and all13 Table1 stage ranges, mass losses and end residues. Ti is a step-start temperature, not T5/T10. Moisture50-160 C is not assigned a decomposition Tmax. AAm Table1 R6001.7 versus body3.34 and AAc firstTi194 versus body242 remain raw auxiliary holds; neither changes uncontested DTG/LOI identities. DMVP Table1 stepII mass-loss63.02 and end-residue27.6 do not close against preceding87.92; retain the published numbers and a nonclosure flag without inferring replacements. LOI Methods/body swap GB/T5454/5455, so preserve both raw statements and leave canonical standard unknown. Preparative NaOH/Soxhlet/boiling-water extraction is not durability laundering. The specific assay dose and monomer-bath concentration are not borrowed from graft-yield plots. Complete7 primary native-text pages,3 tables,8 captions and27 references reviewed;48 source guards,four scientific regressions and28 refreshed canonical comparisons passed,with zero hits. Zero old numerical evidence upgrades or legacy completions;two auxiliary metric holds,one raw mass-balance limitation,and no held whole pair. All1844 prior TG records and every provided new field remain unchanged. No full texts,images or private paths are published.

scope_full_profile_audit.limit: Numeric coincidence audit alone does not prove independence; original-source identity, recipe and reuse evidence govern.

scope_rule: Existing reviewed primary-source fabric/method/washing evidence is reused for the four older DOI cohorts. This is textile-scope adjudication, not a new full-text or numerical review. Every scope observation is bound to the reviewed measurement and material/state/documentary hash; unmatched old scope is pending and contributes zero to target.

textile_scope_report.counting_rule: Admit only evidence-reviewed textile cloth, yarn, nonwoven or source-confirmed textile fibre/application; one source/sample/treatment/washing state is counted once across TG conditions. Paper sheets and dispersed-fibre engineering plastics are excluded. Unknown scope is pending and uncounted.
textile_scope_report.admission_basis: Exact manual scope evidence, material/state/documentary hash and reviewed measurement fingerprint. Pending scope contributes zero to the target.
